body.name: \Phi_{\eta,i}
body.construction: Partition \(\Phi_i\) into the target-pre, donor-pre, donor-post, and factual-post blocks and define \[\Phi_{\theta,i}=\Phi_{y,i}PB+y\mathcal L_M(\Phi_{M,i})B+yP\Phi_{B,i},\quad \Phi_{\eta,i}=(\Phi_{\theta,i}^\top,\Phi_{1,i}^\top)^\top,\quad \Phi_{\tau,i}=q^\top(\Phi_{1,i}-\Phi_{\theta,i}).\]
